card.name: Numbers just before a unit of measure
card.fires_on: Digits or number words inside a quantity where a unit or measure noun is expected next, especially the 7 in 1.73 m2 after mL/min/ in kidney-function cutoffs.

card.writes: It promotes odd name-like word starts and suppresses measure nouns like units, liters and inches, so it seems to hold off a unit word right after the number.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a number, most clearly the 7 in the kidney-function unit 1.73 m2, before the unit appears.
